title: Skill Evaluation Definition
description: Defines a set of test cases for evaluating a skill. Lives at <skill>/evals/evals.json.

skill_name.description: Name of the skill being evaluated. Should match the skill directory name.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Used as directory name in the workspace tree.

prompt.description: The user-facing message the subagent receives. Should read like a realistic user request.

turns.description: Ordered scripted user follow-ups. Each delivered turn resumes the same agent session; absence preserves one-shot dispatch.

expected_output.description: Human-readable description of what a successful response looks like.

files.description: Fixture file paths relative to the skill's evals/ directory. Copied into the subagent's input directory before dispatch.

runs.description: Runs per condition for this eval, for variance reduction; overrides the --runs flag. Defaults to the flag's value (1 unless raised).

isolation.description: Legacy isolation hint retained for config compatibility. Canonical runs already give every (eval, condition, run) dispatch a private environment for diff-scope capture, so 'shared' and 'isolated' currently have the same effective isolation.

skill_should_trigger.description: Whether the skill-under-test is expected to fire on this eval. Defaults to true. Set false for negative evals where correct behavior is NOT invoking the skill (e.g. an over-trigger guard); such evals are excluded from the skill-invocation rate and its validity warning.

assertions.description: Pass/fail criteria, added after iteration 1 when you know what outputs look like.

prompt.description: The user message to deliver as the next conversation turn.

deliver_when.description: Deliver unconditionally, or only when the preceding assistant response contains a question mark.

agent_response_matches.description: Optional Rust regex that must also match the preceding assistant response in agent_asks mode.

check.description: Runner check kind: tool_invocation_matches, or assistant_message_matches for a scripted conversation.

pattern.description: Rust regex matched against a rendered tool invocation or assistant message.

must_precede.description: Where in the run the match must occur. 'completion_claim' = before the final assistant message; 'first_write' = before the first write/patch tool call (passes when no write occurs); 'any' = anywhere in the run.

rubric.description: The question the judge model answers. Should be answerable with PASS/FAIL + evidence.

model.description: Optional judge model override. When absent, defaults to the run-level judge model recorded in conditions.json, or the harness default when no run-level model was selected.

setup_files.description: Optional held-out paths relative to the skill's evals/ directory. The runner injects them into the task environment only during ingest.

command.description: Trusted eval-author command executed by the runner in the task environment after agent dispatch.

env.description: Optional environment-variable overrides applied to the command. Values are strings; an empty string is allowed.

matrix.description: Optional environment matrix. The runner executes one command per Cartesian-product cell; matrix values override same-named env values.

expect_exit_code.description: Expected process exit code. Defaults to 0.

expect_stdout.description: Optional regex matched against the command's complete stdout.

max_files_touched.description: Maximum number of changed, deleted, or newly-created files allowed in the final task environment. Framework files under .eval-magic-outputs are excluded.

max_lines_changed.description: Maximum total byte-lines added plus byte-lines removed allowed. Diffing uses Myers operations with zero-context hunks.
